ownership.postLaunchReview: optional safer custody / multisig review after stable operation

liquidity.addressPolicy: Current Base Mainnet PancakeSwap V3 addresses recorded from official PancakeSwap developer documentation on 2026-09-22; reverify those same identities immediately before launch. Pool address is created/discovered only after the 200 production contract exists.
liquidity.initialLiquidityETHPolicy: At launch, convert no more than EUR 120 into the ETH-side amount using the live ETH/EUR rate. Exact ETH amount is calculated immediately before liquidity creation.
liquidity.v3RangeRationale: Full Range selected for launch simplicity and continuous in-range liquidity because 200 has no established mainnet market price at launch. A narrower range can be reviewed later.
liquidity.v3FeeRationale: 0.25% selected as a moderate EVM V3 fee tier and continuity point with the V2 test environment; 1% was not selected to avoid imposing the highest standard V3 fee on initial trading.

derivedAfterDecision.note: Price ratio and implied FDV must be recalculated from the actual ETH amount selected under the EUR 200 hard cap immediately before launch.

nextAction: ZERO_COST_FINAL_ARTIFACT_AND_PREFLIGHT_PREPARATION; FUNDING NOT REQUIRED UNTIL EXPLICIT MAINNET EXECUTION AUTHORIZATION

referencePriceTrack.note: Illustrative only; not a selected launch valuation.

liquidityModel.note: PancakeSwap V3 on Base Mainnet is the frozen initial liquidity implementation. Fee tier 0.25% and Full Range are frozen. Exact ETH amount and resulting price are dynamic launch-day values. Official contract identities must be reverified immediately before signing.

budget.principle: The EUR 200 figure is a hard ceiling, not a spending target. Unused budget remains unused.
budget.cumulativeHardStop: Before every mainnet transaction, calculate projected cumulative real-money spend. Do not sign if the projected total exceeds EUR 200.
budget.liquidityRule: Initial ETH liquidity must be calculated from a live ETH/EUR price immediately before launch and must not exceed EUR 120.
budget.gasRule: Gas reserve is a ceiling, not an amount that must be spent. If estimated deployment + liquidity gas would exceed EUR 40, stop and reassess.
budget.validationRule: First buy and first sell validation transactions are capped at EUR 10 each. They may be smaller.
budget.contingencyRule: EUR 20 remains uncommitted and is not automatically reassigned.
budget.unusedBudgetRule: Any unused gas/validation/contingency allocation remains unspent unless the user explicitly approves a revised budget.

firstBuy.preferredPolicy: Use the smallest practical test amount up to EUR 10; record quote, minimum received, actual received, tx hash and balances.

firstSell.preferredPolicy: Sell only a small amount acquired/allocated for validation, with value not exceeding EUR 10 at the pre-trade reference; record quote, minimum received, actual received, tx hash and balances.

validationTradePolicy.repeatProtection: Do not repeat a failed or apparently stale transaction until its on-chain status and wallet state are checked.
validationTradePolicy.slippageRule: 1.0% is an absolute validation-trade ceiling, not a target. Stop if the live quote, route or pool state is unexpected.

gasPolicy.rule: Estimate gas immediately before each transaction. If cumulative projected spend breaches any allocation or the EUR 200 overall cap, stop.

approvalPolicy.rule: Prefer exact/minimum necessary approvals. Do not approve unlimited spend when an exact amount is sufficient.

hardStops: Projected cumulative real-money launch spend exceeds EUR 200.
Initial ETH liquidity value exceeds EUR 120.
Projected deployment + liquidity gas exceeds EUR 40.
First buy or sell validation exceeds EUR 10.
Token name, symbol, decimals, supply, mintability or enabled controls differ from frozen configuration.
Deployer/owner wallet differs from the approved launch wallet.
Current PancakeSwap production contract addresses cannot be confirmed from official sources.
Approval spender address differs from the independently confirmed contract.
Unexpected unlimited approval is requested where an exact approval is sufficient.
Liquidity ratio, quote, range, fee tier or recipient differs from the reviewed transaction.
Transaction status is uncertain, stale or pending from a prior attempt.
Source verification does not match the deployed contract artifact where verification is available.
First mainnet buy or sell shows an unexplained token deduction or output outside the slippage guard.

items: Confirm hardware/browser/MetaMask environment is stable and no unexpected wallet popups are present.
Confirm selected MetaMask account is the approved deployer/owner.
Confirm Base Mainnet chain ID 8453 / 0x2105.
Fetch live ETH/EUR price.
Calculate ETH liquidity amount under EUR 120 allocation and EUR 200 total cap.
Fetch/estimate deployment and liquidity gas; stop if combined projection exceeds EUR 40.
Re-verify current official PancakeSwap Base production contracts and preferred production path.
Review exact final token configuration against frozen mainnet-config.json.
Deploy once; do not retry until transaction status is known.
Record deployment transaction and production contract address.
Verify/publish source on BaseScan where supported and compare deployed runtime/configuration.
Read back name, symbol, decimals, totalSupply, owner, pending owner and ERC-2612 domain.
Update canonical public records with mainnet identity only after identity checks pass.
Create 200/WETH liquidity with approved fee tier/range or reviewed current equivalent.
Use exact/minimum approvals and verify spender address.
Record pool/position identity and resulting balances.
Execute first tiny buy at <= EUR 10 with <=1% slippage ceiling.
Verify on-chain receipt and balances before any next transaction.
Execute first tiny sell at <= EUR 10 with <=1% slippage ceiling.
Verify outputs and absence of unexplained token deductions.
Publish mainnet evidence and switch public status to production-live only if all launch checks pass.

funding.rule: Calculate the exact ETH funding amount immediately before transfer using live ETH/EUR. Do not exceed the frozen EUR 200 total launch ceiling.
